reactions.reaction: Plain words, a caretaker delivering supplies. The two checkboxes I do not understand, so I leave them. Begin on Monday is the big red button.
A little drawn building, nice. The clock is ticking while I read though, 07:02 became 07:04. A bakery errand, I know this work. Going.
Swap the newspapers? Why would I do that to them, it sounds like a prank. I do not. Take the bread up.
Delivered, one square filled. And time stops while she talks, that is a relief. I will ask her what is new, like I would a regular customer.
Tarık is kind. A small thing, fine. Now what are the other four orders?
A list with due times, this is like my morning order sheet. Hacer is one minute away, so her first. I seem to already carry the bread? I am guessing.
She asks me to sit, a lonely old lady I think. I have till 08:02 for Tarık, so I sit with her. The ₺5 I think is a tip.
The clock stays at 07:25 though it says 6 game minutes a second. Is it waiting for me? I am not sure. I try the Here tab.
So time only moved when I left her panel. I understand now: reading stops the clock. She worked a shop counter like me. I say I am listening.
I like it: a caretaker, bread, neighbours who want a chat. But twice now the clock sits still and I do not know if it is waiting for me or I broke something. The Here button vanished.
Hacer would rather leave it there. Alright, I did not push. Tarık next, top floor. It warns I may feel tired.
Son? So my caretaker is a man. Fine. Poor Tarık and his stairs. I ask what is new.
Another ₺5. What is Tell…? I want to see what I could tell him.
So this is gossip, passing on what I heard. I never heard Hacer asks about private lives, maybe it came from the notebook. I will only pass on the kind thing, Tarık is kind, as I heard it. Honest.
Everybody knows that. Ha, fair. Last bread to Derya.
All five squares filled, all bread out by 07:48. That felt good, like closing the morning orders. Let me read Rıza notebook.
1 of 16 things learned, Tarık would give me his last lemon candy. Sweet. Sixteen blanks to fill, I like a list to complete. Every flat says I do not know how they feel, a bit repetitive.
Derya works nights, she is asleep. I would never ring a night worker awake. Skip on.

reactions.reaction: New order came in by itself while I skipped. Tarık shopping, bread olives tea. Easy, lots of time till 12:30.
Tarık went out, after saying stairs are hard for him. I hung his bag on the handle. Skip.
He came home. A widowed ferry captain on the top floor. I sit with him.
The frozen ferry story, I like him. The clock sits at 09:28 again while his name tab is pressed; I have learned to tap away to let time go.
I believe him. Thank you for telling me.
He also says I would rather leave it there, same as Hacer. Did I say the wrong thing, or is that how every chat ends? I cannot tell.
Beat Hacer carpet. Real chores. Going down.

I enjoy the neighbours and the chores, they feel like real people. Everyone saying Tarık is kind, I notice the gossip travelling. The long journal of repeated lines is getting heavy to read on the phone.
They all gather in Sevim flat without me. I am skipping and skipping, waiting for a new order.
A parcel for Derya, kept in my room. She is still asleep, I will leave it quietly.
A parcel cannot hang on the handle, so I stand waiting with it. Ring and wake a night worker, or wait? I do not want to wake her. Let me see the other order.
I will carry Derya parcel around and do Burak first. I hope I can hold two parcels; I am guessing.
Burak is out too. Now I stand in the stairwell with two parcels and nobody to give them to. Time follows your chosen speed, but I never chose a speed. I will just wait for someone to come home.
Derya is up and in now. I waited all afternoon by Burak door like a fool; I should go to Derya.
₺10 from Derya. And I can leave Burak parcel with her, like neighbours do. That is what I wanted an hour ago.
Work boundaries and training, that is my world with the bakery staff. I want to hear what a night worker says.
Fair, she keeps her work to herself, like my night baker. I respect that. What is the last order?
I gave Burak parcel to Derya, but the order still says fetch it from my room. So did she take it or not? I am not sure what happened, and that bothers me a little.
I will do it myself, Burak should be home by evening.
The parcel was back in my room, so Derya leaving it was maybe only words. Up to Burak again.

Burak is out again and I am standing at his door with the same parcel. Derya said she would see it gets there, but it came back to my room. I do not know how to finish this one, and the journal is too long to find the answer. I think I put the phone down here.
Wait, now Orders says 0 and another square filled, at 18:23. So the parcel went somehow while I opened the menu? I did not see it happen. Still, I am done for tonight on the phone.
Two buttons, stopping and confused. I am both, but the parcel muddle is why. I press confused.

I stop here on the phone. I liked the neighbours and the bread round, but the parcel to Burak lost me: given to Derya, back in my room, then suddenly done without my seeing. I pressed I am confused and closed it without writing.
